title: Shadow
text: Just as we reached the 70th floor, what emerged was a boss monster tag team—a turtle-shaped monster about as big as we were, called the Spirit Tortoise, paired with something called Brave Peckul Shadow, which I could only describe as a palette-swapped near-copy of Father.
“T-this is… there are two Fathers, I say!”
“No, no way!”

That sharp glare! Surely, even if it wasn’t from the first world, it wouldn’t be strange at all for the Father who couldn’t be saved from his false accusations to appear here in the form of a peckul! I still can’t even explain why I’m looping through worlds in the first place, so in a place this unknown, anything is possible, indeed. I feel like I sort of remember this, and also sort of don’t!
“Peeeeeeeeee!”
Brave Peckul Shadow let out a cry and raised its shield as it approached. With battle seemingly imminent, I stood firm, shielding the other Father.
“Motoyasu! Get out of the way!”
“This Motoyasu has resolved to serve Father with unwavering loyalty no matter what happens, so I cannot, I say!”
“Wait, what about me?”
“Motoyasu-san, you do realize that’s Filo— mmph—”

Father clamped a hand over Itsuki’s mouth before he could finish, shaking his head furiously. Itsuki seemed to understand something, nodding rapidly. Crackling with electricity, the Spirit Tortoise fired a lightning bolt at us from its mouth, and everyone dodged.
“Peeeeeeeeee!”
“Father! Please, calm down, I say! This Motoyasu will accept your wrath no matter what it costs, indeed! That is my atonement!”
Come on, come on! I’ll counter you anytime! Father was flashing me a hate-inducing taunt, beckoning me forward.
“Then what about me!?”
“Motoyasu is unbelievably exhausting! Is that supposed to be Naofumi!?”
“I suppose, from Motoyasu-san’s perspective, a peckul brimming with wild instinct and holding a shield is more genuinely ‘Naofumi’ than the real Naofumi-san.”
“That is deeply offensive!? Is that seriously what I’m like in another world!?”
“Anyway, Motoyasu, you’re in the way! Hundred Sword X!”
“I’ll attack the boss along with that sturdy-looking peckul! Eagle Piercing Shot X!”

Ren, Itsuki! What are you doing to Father!? I thought about striking back, but the other Father had positioned himself to shield Itsuki and the others from my attack, so I couldn’t retaliate! So instead, I stood as far forward as I could to protect Father.
“Guwaaaaaaaaah!”

The skills unleashed by Ren and Itsuki struck me, and the blast carried through to Father standing behind me as well. Ngh… how thoughtful of them, adding damage proportional to defense. I managed to deflect and mitigate the damage, so the battle could continue, indeed.
“Peeeeeeee!”
Come on, come on, hit me harder! Father beckoned from behind while casting healing magic. There didn’t seem to be any healing coming my way. Well, that couldn’t be helped, I say.
“Naofumi! Do something!”
“You say ‘do something’ but… honestly, isn’t just talking sense into Motoyasu-kun the only option? Motoyasu-kun, calm down, that’s not me!”
“But this ferocious temperament is exactly like the other Father, I say.”
“What exactly does the ‘other me’ look like inside Motoyasu-kun’s head? At this point it just sounds like some random monster…”
This too is all my sin, I say.
“Once he’s made up his mind, he charges straight ahead no matter what, doesn’t he. I suppose Motoyasu-san figures that thing is also a Spear Hero of some sort. Shall we try that method again?”
“No, that’s too risky. We should try something else.”
“Agreed. Well then, Naofumi-san.”
Itsuki whispered something into Father’s ear.
“Eh… are you seriously going to do that?”
“It’s just us here. I’m sure it’ll work.”
“That’s right. Just drawing Motoyasu’s attention should be enough. You can handle the rest, Naofumi.”
“Hmm… I really don’t think this’ll go well…”
Wearing a troubled expression, Father approached me as I stood blocking the way, then his face suddenly sharpened into a stern look, and he placed a hand on my cheek.
“Motoyasu, it’s deeply offensive that you’d mistake that thing behind you for me. Is your loyalty so shallow that you’d think even something like that could be me?”
“F-Father?”

W-what is the meaning of this? Is the one standing before me now the gentle Father? Or is it the Father who couldn’t be saved from his false accusations? With that stern expression on his face, I found myself growing confused.
“You can’t even tell the difference between the fake and the real thing. That’s exactly why you’re only worth so much.”
“Ngh…”
I had absolutely nothing to say in response, I say. I almost felt as though I were being scolded by the Father from the very first world.
“But I have built up an image of Father, and even for someone who merely resembles him closely, I cannot simply abandon them, indeed. This too is loyalty to Father.”

“Is your loyalty something you hand out to anything that merely resembles me? I’ll grant you the broad-minded love you show toward Filolials through Filo, but that thing is nothing more than a knockoff peckul carrying a shield! Get a grip!”
“Peeeeeeeee!”

Come on, take this!… Brave Peckul Shadow hurled its shield at me. Clang! It struck me, sending sparks flying. Which meant it had offensive capability, indeed. And that was when I realized Brave Peckul Shadow was not Father. When Father throws his shield, it’s not a skill at all but a unique effect that sends it flying like a frisbee, indeed! He only uses it on Filolial-sama, monsters, or Keel—it has no attack power whatsoever!
“You are not Father, I say! Father cannot use an attack skill that involves throwing his shield, indeed!”
“Motoyasu-san’s criteria for judgment are bizarre.”
“Agreed.”
“That makes me sad, so please stop… the fact that I can’t use Shield Boomerang is subtly a sore point, you know. I do have Frisbee Shield, though.”

Yes, that was a worry shared by every Father across every world, including the one from the first world. This Brave Peckul had gone and casually thrown its shield like that. Which meant, without a doubt, it was not Father, I say.
“However… it is also true that it is a peckul closely resembling Father—it pains me deeply, but I shall finish this in one blow, indeed! For a tough enemy like this, Spiral Aura Spear V!”
Attacking with full force felt somehow inappropriate, so I held back just a little.
“Peeeeee—”
My attack struck Brave Peckul Shadow true, and hit with a blow infused with spiritual energy, it dissolved into mist. After that, we defeated the Spirit Tortoise and cleared that floor.
“This is the emptiest victory I’ve ever had, I say.”
Even knowing it was someone else entirely, it had still been a peckul equipped with a shield, just like Father’s doppelganger.
“Motoyasu-san seems to be in some kind of daze, but I can’t overlook how exhausting that was.”
“Seriously… loyalty is an incredibly annoying thing.”
“Ahaha… I guess it worked out in the end since he understood, but if Brave Peckul Shadow had matched my fighting style exactly, this wouldn’t have gone well at all…”

Father and the others seemed to feel the hollowness of this victory as well, it seemed. And so, on and on we pressed forward. Next to appear was a Riska Shadow-type. In the end, it turned out to be a monster duo called Brave Riska Shadow and Flame Twin.
“New Nambu Destroyer, I say!”
And with that, I blasted it into oblivion with Brionac X.
“Chichi—!?”
“An overwhelming victory, an easy win, a total triumph, I say. There are limits to how weak small fry can be, indeed.”
“I suppose I’ll head out on a rabbit hunt of my own! No more holding back—I’m finishing this in one go!”
Itsuki loaded up and fired a volley at me, but I knocked down every single bullet with Windmill and ran straight on to the next floor, I say!
